scoring_justification: Checker recomputes percolation observables N, P, S from the agent's raw p1/p11/p_b/Q to verify formula consistency, and recomputes P from the exact Bethe-lattice solution (paper's formulas) at selected temperatures to verify correctness of the spin probabilities and percolation function, enforcing the first-order jump.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference percolation probability P recomputed from the paper's analytic Bethe-lattice formulas for q=3, σ=5, p_b=1-θ at selected temperatures (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.58, θ_c, 0.59, 0.7, 1.0).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (3)-(5) and Bethe-lattice Potts solution from refs 18,19; the same formulas the solving agent must implement.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker computes P from scratch using the exact mathematical expressions; no external data used.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The computation reproduces the paper's analytic results; the formulas are public and verifiable, and the checker's implementation matches the reference solve.sh algorithm.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed percolation observables (N, P, S) for the q=3, σ=5, p_b=1-θ system. The checker recomputes N, P, S from the provided probabilities and Q to verify internal consistency, checks the percolation threshold condition, and compares P at the critical and other temperatures to hidden reference values to confirm the first-order jump.

output_contract.notes: The file covers at least 20 values of θ in [0,1]. The agent must implement the Bethe-lattice Potts solution and the root-finding for Q; no pre-made tables are provided.
